'''Anglerbear''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Blizzgrizz]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The searing snow is Anglerbear's playground, and hunting is as easy as a game. An entertaining one, too, especially if the prey are cunning enough to attempt escape."

Anglerbear is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A bipedal polar bear that holds a sailfish like a weapon. A basket for holding smaller fish is strapped across its body. Anglerbear's snout and neck fluff is cyan, arms and legs are blue, and its ears and eyebrows are peach colored. The sailfish is dark blue with red and orange highlights in its fins.

Anglerbear's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of the fish to maroon, and its feet and snout become brown and peach in color.
